name: GE HealthCare Technologies Inc.
business: GE HealthCare sells imaging and ultrasound systems, patient monitoring devices, imaging agents and related services and software to hospitals and healthcare providers worldwide.

events.what: New CFO appointed after Jay Saccaro resigned (effective 2026-08-14; George Newcomb interim)
events.from: EVP and CFO of Xylem since October 2023; SVP and CFO of IDEX 2017 to 2023

events.what: Director added; two directors not standing for re-election
Strategic review of Patient Care Solutions (sale, continued ownership or other transaction)
events.source: Q2 2026 earnings call, document_id 110756 (Baba call summary)

events.what: Tuck-in acquisition of Intelerad (cloud PACS); no Item 2.01 or 1.01 8-K returned, so not material by SEC test
events.source: J.P. Morgan Healthcare Conference, Arduini, 2026-01-13, document_id 52661

next_event.source: No Investor Day scheduled in the Baba corpus (last Investor Day 2024-11-21, document_id 68251). 2027 guidance not yet given (Biegelsen to Arduini, Wells Fargo conference 2026-09-09, document_id 219348); the Q3 2026 call will be Grogan's first as CFO, date not sourced.

margin_framing.metric_basis_note: Target is ADJUSTED EBIT margin, high teens to 20%+ over the 2026 to 2028 medium term (first set by CFO Helmut Zodl at the December 2022 Investor Day on a three to five year view, doc 93030 search hit; the 20%+ wording and 2026 to 2028 window came later, an analyst noting at Investor Day 2024-11-21, doc 68251, that management had added the plus). Baba VA operating_income matches company adjusted EBIT (Q3 2025 14.8% both). The CEO most recently called the range 17 to 20; target_level_pct uses the 17% floor. Calendar fiscal year, no label shift.

statements.quote: But if you think about our aspiration, what we've said is we want to be 17% to high teens to 20% plus by 2028, okay. In order to do that, we need to accelerate some margin improvement.
statements.speaker: James (Jay) Saccaro

statements.quote: And we feel very good about this midterm look between 2026 and 2028 of mid-single-digit revenue growth, high-teens to 20%+ adjusted EBIT, high single-digits to low double-digit on EPS, and 90%+ free cash flow.
statements.speaker: Peter Arduini

statements.quote: We're maintaining full year guidance. This reflects 3%-4% organic sales growth and 10 basis points to 40 basis points adjusted EBIT margin expansion. That gets us to a range of 15.4%-15.7%.
statements.speaker: Peter Arduini
statements.doc_title: GE Healthcare Technologies, Inc. Q2 2026 Earnings Call

statements.quote: Even having those laid on top, which could be worth almost a couple of hundred basis points of headwind. When we said we would be 17-20, we're still on track to that even with those headwinds.
statements.speaker: Pete Arduini

street.gap_assumption: Like for like: management adjusted EBIT target vs VA consensus operating income (adjusted EBIT) over revenue. FY2028 consensus 16.44%; FY2026 15.27% and FY2027 about 15.9%. Gap is 56 bps to the 17% floor and 206 bps to the 18.5% midpoint of 17 to 20. Street also sits below the FY2026 guide (15.27% vs 15.4% to 15.7%), and its FY2026 to FY2028 path adds about 58 bps a year.
street.source: Baba data_financials summary and fundamentals (Visible Alpha consensus), fetched 2026-10-01

evidence_of_progress.note: Order [Q1 2026, Q2 2026], adjusted EBIT margin, CFO on the calls: Q1 13.5% down about 150 bps (tariffs; doc 189150), Q2 14.2% down 40 bps (PCS problems plus memory chip, oil and freight inflation; doc 110756). FY2026 guide 15.4% to 15.7% (+10 to 40 bps) needs about 250 bps of second-half lift over the first half (Wells Fargo conference summary, doc 219348). Orders +11.1% organic, book-to-bill 1.15x in Q2. Q2 2026 actuals are not yet loaded in Baba VA, so LTM EBITDA uses Q2 2025 to Q1 2026.

verdict: Partial GXO match: cheap (10th pctile EV/EBITDA, down 30%) with a dated 17% to 20%+ 2028 adjusted EBIT target the street models only to 16.4%, but the catalyst is a new external CFO under a 57-month CEO, and the target is four years old.
open_questions: Will Grogan reaffirm or re-base the 17% to 20%+ 2028 target on his first call (Q3 2026) or with 2027 guidance?
Does a Patient Care Solutions sale lift group adjusted EBIT margin enough to close the gap mechanically, and what is the dilution?
Can the second half deliver the roughly 250 bps lift over the first half needed for the 15.4% to 15.7% FY2026 guide, given the street is already below the low end?
